name: MeshClient
description: A Meshtastic client for your handheld: read and send messages, browse the mesh, and edit your radio's settings over Bluetooth LE or USB.
author: mcereal

changelog.v2.78.1: The three warnings clang and GCC raised; A write to a radio that has gone resets the link.
changelog.v2.78.0: An inkos UI backend, and the client as an inkos app.
changelog.v2.77.0: Install a Tern node's firmware from the project's feed; Show a Tern node's own fix and receiver, and turn it off; Speak version 9 of the companion protocol; Show a Tern node's presence card on its detail; Speak version 7 of the companion protocol (and 4 more).
changelog.v2.76.0: Speak version 3 of the companion protocol; Speak Tern's companion protocol as a third conversation; Scope message ids to the node, and apply a gap's news live; An expired place's lock binds nobody; Keep a locked place locked against other senders.
changelog.v2.75.1: Ship the Miyoo an icon Onion will draw; Refuse a download built for another machine.
